Ivy (CS): Heads-up: Lumina is scheduling a short exec demo next Wed. They asked for a tiny "pocket ops" guide they can run 5 minutes before the call — focused on caching, batching, streaming, and a 2‑question exec pulse. Can SRE/SE help assemble?
Noah (SRE): I can. Quick Qs: streaming or single-shot? Typical prompt size & peak concurrency?
Lina (Customer): Streaming chat, mostly short turns (~60 tokens). Expect ~45 concurrent during peak. We run large nightly vector jobs at 02:30 but can postpone.
Samir (Solutions Eng): For that profile: preheat KV cache with common opens, set streaming.flush_ms=40, batching.target_tokens=6 OR batching.max_wait_ms=25, enable 1% output sampling for hallucination checks. For demo routes, lower sample rate to 0.5% if needed to cut overhead.
Noah (SRE): Minimal pocket guide (5 bullets):
- Run prime script 6m before start (script below).
- Set streaming.flush_ms = 40 on demo route.
- Set batching.target_tokens = 6 or max_wait_ms = 25.
- Autoscale spike +25% from -5m to +20m; undo after +30m.
- Shift nightly backfill +1h if possible; if not, set its concurrency lower for the window.

Prime snippet:
```
# prime prefixes (1-click)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","prompts":["Hi there","Show my activity","Help me reset password"]}'
```

Samir (Solutions Eng): Embeddings note: run large batches at off-peak; use chunking (400-800 vectors per batch) and exponential retry for 429s starting at 200ms. For demo feel, disable heavy background ingest if possible.
Ivy (CS): Exec pulse (2 Qs): 1) Responsiveness (1-5). 2) Any incorrect/confusing outputs? (Y/N + short). Please ask for a Console latency screenshot for the demo route.
Noah (SRE): Health gate: CS marks account green if post-demo 99th %ile < 230ms and error rate < 0.5% for two demos within 14 days. If gate fails -> amber + SE follow-up. Add renewal flag if still amber after SE fixes.
OpsBot: Reminder set: "Lumina prime" at 2026-04-20T09:54:00Z (owner: Ivy). :bell:
Lina (Customer): This is exactly what we need — we'll shift the backfill and run the prime script. Thanks!
Ivy (CS): Action owners: Ivy -> customer-facing pocket guide + pulse; Noah -> infra autoscale window & healthcheck; Samir -> prime snippet + embed guidance; Lina -> confirm backfill shift. Can everyone confirm by EOD?
Noah (SRE): Confirmed. I'll post infra ticket link.
Samir (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. I'll add a dry-run offer for their ops engineer.
Ivy (CS): Great — we'll collect feedback post-demo and add notes to the public runbook.
